Why Earn a Finance M.B.A. at New York Tech?

Earn your M.B.A. with a finance concentration from New York Tech, where you’ll study in the heart of New York City, the world capital of finance and business. Our AACSB-accredited program combines theoretical knowledge with practical application, preparing you to excel in the competitive world of corporate finance and investment management. 

Our experienced professors and top industry executives will guide you through coursework and real-world projects. You’ll gain critical experience in applying financial concepts, analyzing data from multiple sources, and evaluating diverse investment strategies. 

Master the latest financial technology, including live data sources, Bloomberg terminals, and the Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP) database. These tools will enhance your ability to make informed, strategic financial decisions. 

By the end of our M.B.A. program, you will be able to: 

  • Utilize technology support systems to enhance organizational decision-making processes. 
  • Conduct thorough business analysis using industry-specific and environmental data, bridging the gap between theory and practice. 
  • Identify and analyze contemporary business issues on a global scale, developing and communicating strategic recommendations effectively. 

Our curriculum aligns with the Level I curriculum of the CFA Institute, ensuring you’re prepared for certification. You’ll develop the ability to compile, analyze, and synthesize financial data from various sources, and evaluate investment strategies to meet the objectives of both individual and institutional investors. 

Credits earned in this program can also be applied toward the Business Analytics, Advanced Certificate or Marketing, Advanced Certificate, providing further opportunities for specialization and career growth.

Customize Your Studies

Management, M.B.A.

Our M.B.A. program provides a comprehensive view of the world’s interconnected and complex business landscape—from theories to applications. Throughout your studies, you’ll engage with the latest technologies and gain exposure to a variety of business settings.

M.B.A. – Business Analytics Concentration

Take a data-driven approach to business problems. You’ll learn to deploy the latest analytical tools and skills, including statistical analysis, Python and SQL languages, and Tableau, the leading data analysis and visualization application.

M.B.A. – Finance Concentration (CFA Track)

Enhance your credibility and opportunities in corporate finance with additional courses on top of the finance track to prepare for certification as a Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA).

M.B.A. – Marketing Concentration

Prepare to drive growth through campaigns that connect with diverse audiences. You’ll gain experience with research, data analysis, strategy formulation, and implementation, and learn to leverage the latest tools and applications.

M.B.A. – Operations & Supply Chain Management Concentration

Specialize in the assessment and design of complex business systems. To oversee materials-to-consumer networks, you’ll master rigorous analytical tools and optimize frameworks to meet organizational goals.

Business Administration Essentials

Earn your M.B.A. at your pace through four stackable certificates, or choose one or two to bolster your skills and credentials in target areas. Available programs include a foundational certificate plus Analytical Essentials, Financial Essentials, and Managerial Essentials.

Program Details

Learn more about the Management, M.B.A. with a Finance concentration, including admission requirements, how to apply, and scholarship/funding opportunities. 

New York Tech opens the M.B.A. to recent graduates aspiring to leadership, working professionals pursuing more advanced roles, and international candidates aiming to distinguish themselves in the global workforce.  

To apply, you’ll need: 

  • B.S. degree or its equivalent from an accredited college or university 
  • Minimum undergraduate GPA of 3.0 
  • Completed online application 
  • $50 nonrefundable application fee 
  • Copies of undergraduate transcripts for all schools attended 
  • Copy of your college diploma or proof of degree 
  • GMAT scores are optional 

Note: If you’re applying to an M.B.A. program at NYIT-Vancouver, special requirements apply. Learn more.

Graduate Scholarships and Financial Aid
